description: This is a React component for displaying and managing a list of invitation subscriptions within a preferences/settings UI, including actions like canceling invitations.

methods.name: InvitationsList
methods.description: React functional component that displays active and inactive invitation subscriptions, allowing cancellation of active invitations.

methods.name: handleCancel
